articles.title: ATP to 'wait and see' on Middle East tournaments amid conflict, says chairman Gaudenzi
articles.description: Nov 20 - ATP chairman Andrea Gaudenzi said the men’s tour was taking a “wait-and-see” approach to staging tournaments in the Middle East as the conflict involving Iran, the United States and Israel, along with Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia, raised security and travel concerns across the Gulf. Read more at straitstimes.com.
